[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 50
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- Description: Direct time (engagement/analysis, estimated): root-causing why a contribution appeared 'unverifiable', designing the negative control, and correcting my own overstated claims.
  
  GitHub: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/671 (merged ccfe6df)
  
  Scope: unreported segment only -- the QR-decode work (30 min) and the earlier SOP/guard PRs (240 min) are already on the ledger and are not re-credited.
  
  Analysis performed:
  - Identified the real defect class: the ledger_targets registry only knew the Main Ledger, but [CONTRIBUTION EVENT]s never append there (Stage 1 of CONTRIBUTION_LEDGER_PIPELINE.md writes them to the ops sheet). Aimed at 'main', the scan can only return 'not found' -- which reads as 'the submission failed', and the natural next step, resubmitting, creates duplicate ledger rows. Same false-negative-to-duplicate-row trap the registry was built to stop, one level up.
  - Refused to treat 'not found' as proof of failure and checked the correct target before concluding anything.
  - Designed the negative control that actually proves the fix: same needle against ledger='main' must MISS. Without it, 'found' could simply mean the search was sloppy. It correctly timed out over 6151 rows of the Main Ledger.
  - Read the contributions tab layout live rather than assuming it, discovering row 1 is a banner so the scan needed anchoring at row 3.
  - Diagnosed the deploy confusion: separated 'code merged' from 'process serving it' using file mtime vs service start time, and a direct handler invocation through the service's own EnvironmentFile -- after an earlier 'credentials missing' result that turned out to be an artifact of invoking outside systemd.
  
  Corrections to my own earlier claims, caught before they became record:
  - I had called an untracked submission_guards.py an 'active QR safety guard that deploying main would silently drop'. Grepping app/ showed nothing imports it -- it was dead WIP, not live protection. Overstated severity; corrected on the record.
  - I had reported the deploy tree pinned on a stale feature branch; it was detached at origin/main, 0 ahead / 0 behind. Corrected.
  - I quoted contribution row 15211, then re-verified it as 15209 rather than repeating a stale number.
  - I moved two untracked files out of the live deploy tree, then noticed that left the running branch unable to restart cleanly and restored them; confirmed service active and the module importable.
  - Flagged honestly that my own session's tool schema still advertised only spreadsheet_id/range_a1, so I could not fully 'use the tool instead of handroll' -- and proved the capability by invoking the deployed handler with named-ledger args rather than claiming the schema change was live for me.
--------
